articles.title: Old School Visual Effects: The Cloud Tank (2010)
articles.summary: This article explores the evolution of visual effects, contrasting traditional 'old school' techniques with modern computer-generated imagery (CGI). It highlights how technological advancements in computing have largely rendered many classic practical effects obsolete. The piece reflects on this shift in cinematic visual storytelling, promising to delve into a specific historical technique that has now been superseded by digital methods.

articles.title: What prompted the U.S. military buildup in the Middle East? #politics
articles.summary: The Pentagon has bolstered its military presence in the Middle East, deploying additional naval, air, and missile-defense assets. This significant move comes amidst escalating tensions with Iran and serves as a strategic signal. The deployments aim to reinforce U.S. deterrence capabilities and underscore commitment to regional security, potentially countering perceived threats from Iran.

articles.title: Hellenic Cables: New project for the BC-Wind offshore wind project in Poland
articles.summary: Hellenic Cables has won a contract from DEME to supply crucial inter-array cables for Poland's BC-Wind offshore wind project. This major renewable energy initiative, developed by Ocean Winds (a joint venture of EDP Renewables and ENGIE), signifies international collaboration in sustainable power generation. For SSB aspirants, it underscores global efforts in energy transition and infrastructure development, impacting future energy security and economic partnerships.

articles.title: U.S. military pushes more weaponry into the Middle East for possible strikes on Iran
articles.summary: The Pentagon is deploying significant additional weaponry, including warships, air defenses, and submarines, to the Middle East. This strategic move is in preparation for a potential military strike on Iran, reflecting escalating tensions and a readiness for military action in the region. This aims to bolster US capabilities and deterrence.
